fetch_blog_posts_rss: fetch blog posts from an RSS feed URL with caching and local fallback on failure
fetch_rss_feed_remote: fetch raw RSS XML from a remote URL with a 5-second timeout
parse_rss_to_posts: parse RSS XML text into a list of blog post dictionaries with title, description, date, and url
load_local_blog_posts: load bundled local backup blog posts from the litellm package resources
validate_blog_posts: validate that a list of blog posts is non-empty and returns a boolean
